top_choice_rationale: The recollision model and its quantum formulation identify a surprising microscopic mechanism, repeatedly validated across laboratories, that made high-harmonic generation intelligible and opened a new view of electronic motion. Its citation can remain narrowly confined to this foundational theory rather than the wider attosecond experimental revolution.
recusal_note: I work in attosecond photoionization theory and have long-standing professional connections to the broader Lund attosecond community. The supplied evidence identifies no direct collaboration with the three proposed B020 laureates, but this field-level proximity should be disclosed.
